explanation: The later article states it in one clause, and it is the reason this edge exists rather than the one batch 40 refused: “However Fox and Carysfort were detached with a local convoy in November 1798, and **Rainier, whose forces were largely committed to the Red Sea following the recent French invasion of Egypt**, gave urgent orders for the frigates to be replaced by the 38-gun HMS Virginie and 74-gun HMS Arrogant.” Batch 40 withdrew the raid on Manila because the only text reaching Macau named a third event as the cause and the atlas did not hold it; the third event was this one, and A15(5) says such an edge is written from that event or not at all. It is written from that event. `enabled`: the invasion did not make the Franco-Spanish squadron sail, it took the Royal Navy squadron that would otherwise have been covering the China Fleet and put it in the Red Sea. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
